sentences.text: A study of Phascolarctobacterium faecium in healthy individuals reported colonization rates between 43.33 and 93.33 percent in the human gastrointestinal tract.
The same study reported a gradual increase in these bacteria with increasing age between 1 and 60 years, and a decrease in elderly individuals over 60.

A survey of 7,569 human metagenomes reported an association between Phascolarctobacterium faecium and non-obese adults regardless of nationality, sex or age, with anti-obesogenic effects confirmed in mice.
